description: This file defines the ZoneService interface, which extends the generic service interface to manage Zone entities, including methods for retrieving zones by code or country and language, adding descriptions, and fetching zone maps.

classes.name: ZoneService
classes.description: An interface extending the generic sales manager entity service for managing Zone entities with additional methods specific to zones.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Zone entity based on its code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Associates a description with a given Zone, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns a list of zones associated with a given country and language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns a map of zones keyed by string identifiers for a specific language.
